clues: This startup developed Lucy, an AI tool capable of real-time video editing.
Its flagship platform, DOS, compresses the process of adapting AI models for alternative processors down to a couple of weeks.
It created Oasis, an interactive model that generates playable simulated environments in real time as users interact with it.
Founded in 2023 by three Israeli engineers, this startup received early access to AWS's Trainium3 processors in 2025.
Nvidia nearly finalized acquiring it in August 2026, before Anthropic bid up to $7 billion but walked away after due diligence.
Amazon entered talks in October 2026 to acquire this startup for roughly $7 billion to optimize workloads for Trainium3 chips.
